title: Public customer portal: signup / plan / buy / activate
body:
## Original (as captured)
Signup, choose plan, checkout, receive + activate key, renew/upgrade, trial start/expiry, support.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0066)
Public signup -> plan select -> checkout/payment (provider deferred) -> issue license -> provision tenant; renewals/upgrades/cancel; webhook from the billing provider. Pricing provisional/operator-configurable.
